title.zh: 【MoonPay 在韩国成立子公司，计划将其打造为亚太扩张中心】
title.en: 【MoonPay 在韩国成立子公司，计划将其打造为亚太扩张中心】

current_state.zh: MoonPay has set up a South Korean subsidiary intended as its APAC expansion center, partnering with KakaoBank, Woori Bank and KB Financial Group on cross-border payments, KRW stablecoin distribution, e-wallets and crypto deposit/withdrawal channels.
current_state.en: MoonPay has set up a South Korean subsidiary intended as its APAC expansion center, partnering with KakaoBank, Woori Bank and KB Financial Group on cross-border payments, KRW stablecoin distribution, e-wallets and crypto deposit/withdrawal channels.
